item.title: Medical Research Data Scientist - University of California - San Francisco
item.description:
The Medical Research Data Scientist will work in the Department of Neurology under the direction of the Principal Investigator and in collaboration with faculty investigators, biostatisticians, research staff, trainees, and data analysts. The position will support epidemiologic studies of Parkinson’s disease and related neurological disorders, applying data science and statistical methods to investigate disease risk, progression, treatment effectiveness, and patient outcomes.
The Medical Research Data Scientist will apply advanced data science, statistical, and computational methods to complex research projects. The successful candidate will work with large and diverse data sources, including electronic health records, administrative data, and longitudinal research data. This may include developing and implementing data collection approaches using wearable devices to track environmental exposures, geolocation, and continuous biometric measures, such as electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings. They will develop reproducible approaches to cleaning, linking, managing, and analyzing these data and will work independently to address complex analytical and computational challenges.
The Medical Research Data Scientist will also serve as a technical resource for multidisciplinary research teams, helping investigators identify appropriate statistical and computational approaches and develop tools and workflows for complex analyses. They may provide technical guidance to other research staff and analysts.
Key responsibilities include:
* Collaborate with faculty investigators, biostatisticians, research staff, trainees, and data analysts to achieve study objectives. * Builds automated systems to produce up-to-date reports on key statistics and participation of ongoing studies. * Develop multivariable analysis plans in consultation with investigators and biostatisticians and independently conduct analyses using appropriate statistical methods. * Analyze large collections of electronic health record (EHR) notes, including datasets with millions of records, using natural language processing (NLP) methods and large language models (LLMs) in R and Python through UCSF-approved, PHI-safe API infrastructure. * Conduct computationally intensive data processing and analysis using high-performance computing resources, including Linux computing clusters and other distributed computing environments.
* Develop dynamic reports, data visualizations, and other tools to communicate study progress and research findings to investigators, collaborators, sponsors, and broader audiences.
* Link records across multiple administrative and research datasets using deterministic and probabilistic matching methods.
* Write clear, reproducible, well-documented code using Git for version control, with code quality and documentation suitable for sharing in public repositories.
* Develop clear documentation of data management and analytical methods and contribute statistical and technical sections to grant proposals, manuscripts, presentations, and reports.
* Contribute to study design and help ensure that appropriate, high-quality data are collected to address study hypotheses and research objectives.
* Collaborate with investigators on scientific manuscripts and other research products.
The mission of the Department of Neurology at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) includes delivering the most exceptional clinical care to our patients, leading transformative cutting-edge research, and training the leaders of tomorrow in both neurology and neuroscience. Our department’s faculty, trainees, and staff work at a University and in a community that values and embraces diversity and strives to make an impact worldwide through our global and public health efforts.
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer / Computational / Data Science, or Domain Sciences with computer / computational / data specialization and five years of experience or equivalent experience/training. * At least two (2) years of experience in medical research and a total of 5 years of experience in medical or a related research field. * At least three (3) years experience using Git version control software. * Advanced knowledge of High Performance Computing and data science. * Thorough skills in programming, statistical analysis and data management in Python or R. * Experience evaluating and analyzing large-data electronic health record (EHR) notes (millions of entries) applying natural language processing (NLP) methods and large language models (LLM) via R and Python packages using UCSF-approved LLM API infrastructure. * Highly advanced skills, and demonstrated experience associated with one or more of the following: HPC hardware and software power and performance analysis and research, design, modification, implementation and deployment of HPC or data science tools of large-scale scope. * Demonstrated ability to regularly, effectively communicate with unit-level management. * Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization and to external research and education audience, in a clear and concise manner both verbally and in writing. * Substantive knowledge of quantitative research methods and casual inference. * Extensive experience conducting statistical analysis of observational studies, program evaluations, administrative data or longitudinal cohorts. * In depth skills and experience in independently resolving complex computing / data problems using introductory and / or intermediate principles. * Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. * In depth ability to successfully work and / or lead multiple concurrent projects. Demonstrated research and technology project leadership and management skills. * In depth experience assessing a broad spectrum of technical and research needs and demands and establish priorities, delegate and / or lead development of solutions to meet such needs. * The ability to work with a variety of data sources, including administrative and longitudinal survey data and will be able to clean, manage, link, and analyze these sources.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Computer / Computational / Data Science, or Domain Sciences with computer / computational / data specialization preferred. * Experience working with medical researchers. * Experience working with health-related outcome measures. * Experience with geocoding via tools such as ArcGIS or Google Earth. * Experience annotating and analyzing large genomic datasets.

item.title: Data Scientist, Bellwether, X - X Development
item.description:
Software EngineeringMountain View, CA
**About X, the Moonshot Factory**
X is a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup.
**About the Team:**
Our team – Bellwether – operates at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and pressing issues with enterprise customers, governments, and more. We focus on severe weather manifestations of climate change, such as wildfires, and aim to use a wide range of data and analytics to better understand and predict what these events could mean for communities and businesses across the globe. We do this through the detection and classification of the features and patterns of the natural and built worlds, the application of cutting-edge machine learning, and the redesign of the full geo-ML workflow. This work extends into development and production-level work as well, as Bellwether also has a number of products that are live with customers. The result: tools and models that allow a range of industries to better leverage earth observation insights.
**About the Role:**
We are looking for a **Lead Data Scientist** to build and unify the data infrastructure that powers our model training pipelines for Project Bellwether. In this role, you will lead the effort to construct a comprehensive multimodal data corpus—integrating geospatial, imagery, sensor, and operational feeds—that serves as a strategic moat for pre- and post-disaster response and resilience.
Your primary focus will be designing automated ingestion pipelines for complex multimodal datasets, establishing rigorous data quality validation frameworks, and managing dataset versioning to support continuous machine learning training loops. You will bridge the gap between operations, remote annotation teams, and machine learning engineers to ensure our disaster-response models are trained on reliable, high-fidelity, and well-structured data.
**How you will have 10X impact:**
* Architect and build automated ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) data pipelines to aggregate, clean, and harmonize data from disparate sources, databases, and operational ingestion flows. * Implement DataOps practices, including data quality monitoring, automated schema validation, and anomaly detection to catch corrupt or mislabeled data early. * Standardize and integrate third-party annotation workflows and remote labeling feeds into unified datasets ready for model training. * Design and maintain dataset versioning and storage systems to allow reproducible machine learning experiments and seamless data retrieval. * Partner with ML engineers and operations teams to turn geospatial, imagery, and sensor metadata into structured training features. * Lead the end-to-end development of multimodal machine learning models, driving innovation from research and dataset architecture to production deployment for pre- and post-disaster response. * Define product and data strategy around the multimodal data corpus, leveraging proprietary datasets as a strategic moat for AI-driven disaster resilience tools. * Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize model performance, scalability, and integration into existing product workflows. * Establish best practices for MLOps, including model versioning, automated testing, and performance tracking to ensure reliable and high-quality deployments. * Help hire and grow the data science function, setting the technical bar and culture as the team scales. * Design, build, and maintain robust data ontologies and taxonomies to systematically organize, categorize, and integrate complex geospatial and multimodal datasets.
**What you should have:**
* Education: Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * Data Engineering & Architecture: 7+ years experience building scalable data pipelines, managing relational and non-relational databases, and unifying fragmented data storage systems. * Modern Python Proficiency: Expertise in Python and data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, or SQL). * Data Quality & DataOps: Practical experience implementing automated data validation, quality control frameworks, and dataset versioning practices. * ML Data Lifecycle Understanding: Hands-on experience structuring datasets specifically for machine learning workflows, including handling annotations, metadata tracking, and training set curation.
**It’d be great if you also had these:**
* Pipeline Design & Ingestion: Construct automated ELT/ETL pipelines to aggregate, clean, and integrate complex geospatial, satellite image, and telemetry streams into unified repositories at scale and large volume. * Quality Governance & DataOps: Deploy comprehensive data validation systems, schema checks, and anomaly monitoring to ensure machine learning components rely on robust, high-fidelity information. * Versioning & Tracking: Maintain structured dataset versioning infrastructure to enable reproducible model testing and efficient retrieval of operational features. * Workflow & Label Integration: Harmonize external labeling pipelines and annotation feeds into streamlined, model-ready training assets. * Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders to convert complex sensor attributes into targeted features for prediction pipelines. * Geospatial Data: Experience working with geospatial data (good knowledge of data sources and formats), GIS tools, and spatial analytics libraries (e.g., GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio, Shapely, Zarr, COGs…).
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $207,000 - $311,000 + bonus + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the Engine Security Behavioral Detection team, you will focus on building scalable ML systems to detect malicious behavior, automated play, and exploits using real-time or offline analysis to ensure platform safety and integrity. You will be at the forefront of protecting the Roblox community, developing sophisticated models that distinguish between legitimate player interactions and adversarial activities in a massive, dynamic 3D ecosystem. You will own the lifecycle of detection models, from identifying emerging threat patterns to deploying high-throughput inference services. Your work will bridge the gap between complex behavioral analysis and system-wide mitigation, ensuring that Roblox remains a safe and fair environment for millions of creators and players globally.
You Will:
* Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines for anomaly detection and behavior analysis. * Develop and deploy models that can identify complex, adversarial bot patterns and game exploits. * Work on real-time or offline inference systems that can mitigate malicious activity without disrupting user experience. * Collaborate with security teams, data scientists, and backend engineers to harden the platform against evolving threats.
You Have:
* PhD or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field. * 4+ years of experience in ML engineering, specifically in behavior modeling, anomaly detection, or fraud detection. * Proficiency with time-series analysis, neural networks, or large-scale classification systems. * Experience training and deploying models on high-throughput, low-latency production systems. * Proficiency in Python (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and familiarity with big data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, or similar). * Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for platform integrity and security.
Job Expectations:
* Deliver high-impact ML solutions that directly improve platform security and trust. * Take ownership of model monitoring and retuning strategies to counter adaptive adversary tactics. * Provide technical guidance on best practices for feature engineering in adversarial domains. * Maintain operational excellence, ensuring reliability and scalability of detection services.

item.title: Applied Scientist, Superconducting Digital and Cryogenic Control Electronics,Center for Quantum Computing, Physical Design and Simulation, Enabling Technologies - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking an Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Controlling and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in.
Key job responsibilities
* Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control * Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs * Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations * Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system * Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports * Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues
About the team The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* 3+ years of building models for business application experience * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing * Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Master's degree or above in a relevant field * Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals * Experience with circuit design and simulation * Familiarity with superconducting qubit control and readout — pulse generation, multiplexed readout, feedback latency requirements * Experience designing superconducting digital circuits (RSFQ/ERSFQ, adiabatic quantum phase parametron, or related single-flux-quantum logic families), including Josephson-junction circuit simulation and margin analysis * Experience with EDA flows for custom circuit design — schematic capture, layout, physical verification, and working against a process design kit
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development * Knowledge of cryogenic electronics more broadly: cryo-CMOS, low-temperature amplifiers and mixers, thermal and power budgeting across refrigerator stages * Experience with microwave engineering and signal integrity in dense cryogenic interconnect * Experience taking chips through fabrication and correlating measured circuit behavior with design models * Familiarity with quantum error correction decoding and the classical-processing requirements it places on control systems

**Job Description** Partners with science, engineering, and product experts and leaders to identify strategic business and product needs, and drives and plans the identification of solutions to address product and/or business problems. Leads the design and execution of research programs; surveying state of the art, preparing high-quality datasets, running POCs/experiments, and designing, training, and optimizing ML/AI models and solution architectures. item.title: Sr. Lead Data Scientist - Early Warning
item.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.
Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.
Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.
The Sr. Lead Data Scientist is a senior individual contributor and technical leader within the data science organization, responsible for designing, developing, and delivering advanced machine learning and statistical solutions in a complex, high-volume, high-throughput data environment. This role plays a critical leadership function by owning end-to-end modeling initiatives, guiding analytical direction for major business problems, and mentoring data scientists across multiple projects.
This position is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence modeling standards and best practices, and partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to translate strategic objectives into scalable, production-ready analytics solutions.
**Essential Functions** **Advanced Modeling & Technical Leadership**
* Leads the design, experimentation, and implementation of advanced machine learning, statistical, and optimization models to solve complex, high-impact business problems. * Serves as the technical owner for large-scale, business-critical models, including model selection, feature engineering, training strategy, validation, and performance monitoring. * Drives development of complex consumer or entity profiles used for both offline model training and real-time scoring. * Assesses and ensures long-term performance, stability, scalability, and interpretability of analytically derived models in production environments. * Establishes modeling standards, evaluation frameworks, and best practices adopted across the data science team.
**Project & Cross-Functional Leadership**
* Takes a lead role in the development and delivery of product-prototype and production models, coordinating across multiple data science and engineering contributors. * Partners with software engineers and MLOps teams to define statistical components, data requirements, unit testing, acceptance testing, and deployment strategies. * Translates ambiguous, high-level business goals into clearly defined analytical problems, roadmaps, and measurable success criteria. * Identifies and recommends new modeling, analytics, and data opportunities aligned with business strategy.
**Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing**
* Acts as a senior mentor and subject matter expert, coaching junior and mid-level data scientists on modeling techniques, analytical thinking, and technical execution. * Reviews analytical work, model designs, and code for quality, rigor, and alignment with best practices. * Shares knowledge of emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies through documentation, presentations, and informal leadership.
**Communication & Documentation**
* Clearly documents model design, assumptions, workflows, and performance results for both technical and non-technical audiences. * Presents analytical findings, model outcomes, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership with clarity and confidence.
**Data Stewardship & Compliance**
* Supports the company’s commitment to protecting the integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of systems and data. * Ensures models and analytical solutions adhere to governance, regulatory, and ethical standards.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field. * Typically 10+ years of professional experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical analysis, or equivalent advanced education and experience. * Extensive hands-on experience working with large, complex datasets in high-volume environments. * Advanced proficiency in data science and machine learning tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Java, or equivalent. * Deep experience with a broad range of machine learning methods, including classification, regression, tree-based models, SVMs, ensemble methods, and optimization techniques. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into robust analytical designs and production-ready models. * Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating data scientists on complex projects. * Successful completion of background and drug screening.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* PhD or Master’s Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field. * Deep expertise in advanced machine learning algorithms and modern ML frameworks and libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Strong experience writing, optimizing, and tuning complex SQL queries. * Experience designing and maintaining data science pipelines and workflows in Python, R, or similar languages. * Experience working with financial or regulated data environments. * Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while balancing multiple priorities. * Track record of discovering non-obvious insights and patterns in complex datasets.
Physical Requirements
Working conditions consist of a normal office environment. Work is primarily sedentary and requires extensive use of a computer and involves sitting for periods of approximately four hours. Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling, and reaching. Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently. Requires visual acuity and dexterity to view, prepare, and manipulate documents and office equipment including personal computers. Requires the ability to communicate with internal and/or external customers.

item.title: Principal Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research - SAP
item.description:
**Job Description** **Teach AI how business actually works** AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough.
SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP's AI workspace, accurate enough to trust.
As Principal Data Scientist, you will define and lead our research toward that goal and work with product teams to ship the results. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics.
**What You Will Work On**
* A research agenda with a point of view. Pick the two or three bets where SAP can lead in AI on business data, agree up front how we will know each one is working, and stop the ones that aren't. Closely collaborate with top universities and institutes such as Stanford HAI. * What comes next. Track emerging research, such as relational and graph foundation models, neuro-symbolic agents and context graphs, test it on SAP data before the market settles, and make the case for the next bet. * Business semantics that can be learned. New methods to learn, align and evolve ontologies and knowledge graphs of business objects, rules and actions from SAP metadata, master data, documents and process data, combining LLM-assisted ontology learning, schema matching and entity resolution with targeted expert review. * Agents grounded in business semantics. Graph-grounded retrieval; semantic parsing into SQL, SPARQL and OData calls, including finding the right API, across very large schemas; and governed actions: checks that an agent's plan respects business rules and the user's authorizations before it runs. * Models that combine structure and statistics. Graph learning and relational foundation models (such as SAP-RPT-1.6), using knowledge-graph structure to predict, explain and simulate business outcomes. * The yardstick. Benchmarks and simulation environments for agents on ERP data, where today's public benchmarks fall short, so SAP knows when AI is accurate and reliable enough to act on. * Results that land. Work directly with data teams and domain experts in co-innovation projects, turning messy enterprise data problems into tractable ontology problems, and work with the teams behind SAP Knowledge Graph, SAP Business Data Cloud and Joule, SAP's AI assistant, to ship what works. * A stronger research community. Publish at top venues, release code and benchmarks where we can, co-lead university collaborations, and mentor scientists and PhD interns.
**In Your First Year, Success Could Look Like**
* Two or three research directions you defined, agreed with leadership, at least one with a product partner and one longer-horizon * A result running in an SAP product or pilot * Papers submitted, and a benchmark or open-source release others use * Scientists doing better work because of you
**Qualifications** **What you'll bring** **Required**
* Typically 8+ years in applied research, data science or machine learning, or a PhD and 5+ years, including research you led that changed a product or platform. An MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Deep expertise in one of these areas and hands-on experience in another, with at least one of the two in knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic data integration:
+ Knowledge graphs, ontologies and semantic data integration: RDF, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL or property graphs; ontology and schema matching; entity resolution; semantic layers; you have made the hard modeling calls yourself (entity boundaries, inheritance, relationship semantics), not just queried existing graphs + Machine learning on relational, graph or tabular data: GNNs, relational deep learning, relational or tabular foundation models + LLM systems over structured data: retrieval, tool and API discovery, text-to-SQL and schema linking, tool-using agents, fine-tuning or post-training + Evaluation and benchmark design for AI systems
* Strong foundations in machine learning and statistics; fluent in Python and SQL, with PyTorch or JAX; at ease with schemas spanning thousands of related tables. * Strong problem solving skills, shown by concrete examples: you have turned an ambiguous business question into a crisp, testable research problem, started with the simplest approach that could work, and stopped or redirected work, including your own, when the evidence said so. * Strong communication skills, shown by concrete examples: you can explain a trade-off to an executive concisely and clearly. A paper, design doc or memo of yours led a team outside your own to adopt, fund or drop something. You are able to work through a design with skeptical engineers.
**Preferred**
* Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL/EMNLP, SIGMOD/VLDB, ISWC, WWW, or widely used open-source software, datasets or semantic standards work. * LLM-assisted ontology learning, neuro-symbolic methods, agent memory, context graphs and decision traces, or reinforcement learning for tool-using agents. * Process mining (including object-centric event data), causal inference, forecasting, or privacy-preserving and synthetic data. * Familiarity with how enterprises run (finance, supply chain, procurement, HR), and experience mentoring scientists or leading university collaborations. * SAP experience is a plus, not a requirement.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI, in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.
If you recognize yourself here but do not match every line, apply.
**Where you belong** We are SAP Research & Innovation North America, a team of scientists and engineers at SAP Labs in Palo Alto, minutes from Stanford. We look a few years ahead and scout emerging technologies, take the early, riskier bets that product teams can’t always take, and prove or drop them fast. SAP's product teams build and run SAP Knowledge Graph, we look beyond and find and prove methods that demonstrate improvement or paradigm shifts. Our job is to spot the opportunities that will matter most to SAP and our customers, and to get there early. We prototype with dedicated GPU compute on realistic business data and, in co-innovation projects, on real data for training and evaluating models. We publish research, work with startups, universities and institutes including Stanford HAI and UC Irvine, and hand what works to SAP's product teams. We move like a small lab, with the reach of a company whose software runs finance

item.title: AI Data Scientist Technical Leader (Hybrid) - Cisco
item.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 11/30/2026
This is a hybrid role based thrice a week in Cisco's San Jose, CA office.
**Meet The Team** We are seeking a highly skilled AI Data Scientist / Data Analyst to join our Silicon One Hardware Engineering team. In this role, you will leverage sophisticated analytics, machine learning, and AI agent technologies to drive yield analysis, debug, and predictive modeling for our semiconductor manufacturing processes. Your work will directly impact product quality, test cost, manufacturing efficiency, and time-to-market for Cisco’s industry-leading silicon solutions.
**Your Impact**
* Develop, deploy, and maintain AI/ML models for yield analysis, yield debug, and early-stage failure prediction in semiconductor manufacturing. * Build and optimize AI agents to automate data-driven root cause analysis and yield improvement initiatives. * Analyze large-scale manufacturing, test, and parametric datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and actionable insights. * Collaborate with hardware, test, and process engineering teams to translate business and technical requirements into robust data science solutions. * Design and implement predictive models to forecast yield and quality metrics at various stages of the manufacturing flow. * Communicate findings and recommendations to multi-functional teams through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations. * Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, data analytics, and semiconductor manufacturing best practices. * Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
**Minimum Qualifications**
* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field. * 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or data analytics, preferably in semiconductor or hardware engineering environments. * Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch). * Experience building, validating, and deploying AI/ML models for classification, regression, anomaly detection, and time-series forecasting. * Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks and automation of data analysis workflows. * Solid understanding of semiconductor manufacturing, test data, and yield analysis concepts. * Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., matplotlib, seaborn, Tableau, Power BI).
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies. * Familiarity with Optuna or other hyperparameter optimization frameworks. * Knowledge of hardware debug, root cause analysis, and reliability engineering.
Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

item.title: Data Scientist, Meta Superintelligence Labs (Safety) - Meta
item.description:
We're seeking Data Scientists to join the Safety team within MSL (Meta Superintelligence Labs).As a Data Scientist in Safety, you will establish the analytical foundations that allow us to advance personal superintelligence safely and securely. You will help us turn complex, ambiguous risks with incomplete ground truth into measurable systems across model evaluations and online monitoring. You'll work with engineering, research, product, policy, and legal to design and build measurement and mitigation strategies, quantifying trade-offs between user friction and safety risks.
Data Scientist, Meta Superintelligence Labs (Safety) Responsibilities:
* Measure abuse: build statistical telemetry and measurement frameworks to detect and monitor policy violations or emergent harms * Scale model evaluation: design a scalable framework adapting to evolving agentic model capabilities and safety/risk landscape, grounded in statistics * Evaluate and optimize safeguards: scale offline and online performance evaluation of our safeguards using human-in-the-loop and active learning * Design experiments and analyses: Conduct controlled experiments and rollouts to evaluate the impact of policy or risk definition changes and safety mitigations * Build intelligence and reporting: build signals, pipelines, dashboards to enable real-time monitoring driving interventions and safety roadmaps
Minimum Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 12+ years of experience in product data science, applied analytics, or quantitative research, including leading complex analytical workstreams in an individual contributor capacity * 12+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python or R), and statistical or mathematical software for large-scale data analysis * Experience developing and applying advanced statistical methods including predictive modeling, causal inference, experimentation design, and time series forecasting in a product context * Experience influencing product strategy and executive decision-making through data-driven narratives, written analytical frameworks, and stakeholder alignment across multiple cross-functional teams * Experience establishing analytical standards, data infrastructure best practices, or measurement frameworks adopted broadly across an organization or business domain
Preferred Qualifications:
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Experience defining and scaling self-service analytics platforms or data explorability tools that reduce time-to-insight for non-technical stakeholders * Demonstrated use of AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, including responsible validation of AI-generated outputs and adherence to ethical AI practices * Background in ambiguous and sparse data environments to operationalize e.g. harm prevalence measurement, causal inference, root-cause analysis– rooted in quantitative and statistical foundations * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity, cross-functional environments – able to jump from agentic trace deep-dives to explaining risk dimensions in plain English to policy stakeholders * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or Operations Research * Experience in frontier AI products or risks, and navigating online, adversarial environments in Trust & Safety or Fraud/Risk/Security domains. Model evals, threat modelling, actor telemetry, human-in-the-loop review systems don’t sound foreign to you
About Meta:
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.
$210,000/year to $281,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. item.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Applied AI Solutions - Amazon Web Services (AWS)
item.description:
**Description** AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
Just Walk Out (JWO) is a new kind of store with no lines and no checkout-you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!
Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we'll charge your account and send you a receipt. Check it out at amazon.com/go. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems, and hardware design.
Key job responsibilities
* Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment that's more startup than big company. We'll need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: computer vision, image recognition, machine learning, real-time and distributed systems. * As a Sr. Applied Scientist you will help solve a variety of technical challenges and mentor other scientists. You will be the thought leader of the team. You will tackle challenging novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative you'll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that frankly haven't been solved at scale before - anywhere. Along the way we guarantee that you'll learn a ton, have fun, and make a positive impact on millions of people. * Develop a novel framework and advance the theory and practice of multi-object tracking, re-identification, person activity understanding, multi-modal foundation model, and generic video understanding. Create innovative techniques for efficient visual processing that can scale to real-world applications. Investigate approaches to reduce the computational and data requirements of visual AI systems.
**About The Team** Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
**Basic Qualifications**
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. * Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. This role will be based in the **New York City** office. Our team follows a hybrid schedule working in-office three days a week and remotely for the rest.
**What You'll Do** **Each day can be different here at Nexxen, but some of the things you can expect to be doing daily are:**
* Design, implement, evaluate and help deploy machine learning models for bidding, pacing, KPI prediction (Click, Action, Viewability etc.) and Forecasting. * Analyze large-scale behavioral and performance data using Spark (Scala/PySpark), SQL, and Python. * Deep dive into complex, legacy codebases; you should be comfortable navigating and improving existing systems. * Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and other data scientists to define problems and deliver end-to-end solutions. * Write clear, concise technical documentation and communicate insights effectively across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Master’s in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Operations Research, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field * 5+ years of experience in a data science or applied machine learning role, ideally in a high-scale, real-time environment. * Proficient with applied machine learning techniques (classification, regression, evaluation metrics, etc.), especially tree-based models like XGBoost. * Comfortable navigating large, complex legacy codebases and proposing changes to production systems. Bonus: comfortable using LLM-based tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation. * Strong programming skills in Python, and SQL. * Experience with Scala/Apache Spark for distributed data processing and machine learning at scale. * Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to synthesize technical findings into clear, actionable insights. * Self-directed, curious, and able to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

item.title: Senior Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research - SAP
item.description:
**Job Description** **What you'll build** **Teach AI How Business Actually Works** AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough.
SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP’s AI workspace, accurate enough to trust.
As a Senior Data Scientist, you'll own a research thread end to end: from an open question, to a method and a benchmark, to a prototype a product team adopts. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics.
**What You Will Work On**
* Research you own. Take an open question from ambiguous framing to a reproducible result, and decide what to do next based on what you find. Closely collaborate with top universities and institutes such as Stanford HAI. * What comes next. Reproduce promising new papers on SAP data within weeks and recommend which deserve a bigger bet. * Better ways to build the semantic layer agents need. New methods to learn and maintain ontologies of business objects, processes, rules and actions, with SAP's semantic models as the backbone and LLMs, schema matching and entity resolution to extend them. * Agents grounded in business context. Graph-augmented retrieval and text-to-query agents (SQL, SPARQL, APIs) over very large schemas, with checks against business rules and access rights, and governed actions. * Models that learn from relational data. Graph neural networks and relational foundation models, such as SAP-RPT-1.6, applied with knowledge-graph context to prediction, anomaly detection and what-if analysis. * Honest measurement. Datasets, benchmarks and evaluation harnesses that show whether an approach works on realistic enterprise data, and why, using synthetic or privacy-preserving data where real data can't be shared. * Work others can use. Clean Python that others build on, prototypes built together with (and adopted by) product and engineering teams, published research papers or open-source releases, and mentoring for interns.
**In Your First Year, Success Could Look Like**
* Own one research thread end to end, hands on. For example, schema linking for agents over SAP finance data, taken from baseline to benchmark to a prototype a product team adopts. * A paper submission or open-source release.
This is a senior individual-contributor role, comparable to Senior Research or Data Scientist at other Bay Area technology companies.
**Qualifications** **What you'll bring** **Required**
* Typically 5+ years of hands-on data science, machine learning or applied research, or a PhD plus 2+ years, taking projects from an open question to a measurable result. An MS or PhD in computer science, machine learning, statistics, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Hands-on depth in at least one of the following, and an appetite to learn the others:
+ Knowledge graphs, ontologies or semantic layers: RDF, OWL, SHACL, SPARQL, or property graphs with Cypher or similar + Entity resolution, schema matching or data integration + Machine learning on relational, graph or tabular data, including GNNs + LLM systems over structured data: text-to-SQL, schema linking and API discovery, GraphRAG, agents, evaluation
* Solid foundations in machine learning and statistics, with disciplined experimentation: strong baselines, ablations, leakage-safe splits, error analysis and honest reporting of what didn't work. * Strong Python and SQL, and PyTorch or a similar framework; at ease with large, messy, multi-table data. * Strong problem solving skills, shown by concrete examples: you have turned a vague question into an experiment that gave a clear answer within weeks. * Strong communication skills, shown by concrete examples: you have written up a negative or mixed result clearly enough that others acted on it, and you can explain your work concisely verbally and on a one pager to a scientist or executive.
**Preferred**
* Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL/EMNLP, SIGMOD/VLDB, ISWC, WWW, or contributions to open-source projects. * Graph databases, vector search, or large-scale data processing such as Spark. * LLM-assisted ontology learning or knowledge-graph construction. * LLM fine-tuning or post-training, or MCP. * Process mining, causal inference or forecasting, and familiarity with enterprise processes such as finance, procurement or supply chain. * SAP experience is a plus, not a requirement.
If you recognize yourself here but do not match every line, apply.
**Where you belong** We are SAP Research & Innovation North America, a team of scientists and engineers at SAP Labs in Palo Alto, minutes from Stanford. We look a few years ahead and scout emerging technologies, take the early, riskier bets that product teams can’t always take, and prove or drop them fast. SAP’s product teams build and run SAP Knowledge Graph, we look beyond and find and prove methods that demonstrate improvement or paradigm shifts. Our job is to spot the opportunities that will matter most to SAP and our customers, and to get there early. We prototype with dedicated GPU compute on realistic business data and, in co-innovation projects, on real data for training and evaluating models. We publish research, work with startups, universities and institutes including Stanford HAI and UC Irvine, and hand what works to SAP's product teams. We move like a small lab, with the reach of a company whose software runs finance, supply chain and HR for many of the world's largest companies.
This is a senior individual-contributor role, comparable to Senior Research or Data Scientist at other Bay Area technology companies. The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Palo Alto office, and involves travel of up to 10%.
Additional Information
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
**About SAP** With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.
We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help eve

We’re profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution, transforming from the internet’s most trusted deal forum into the go to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast moving, collaborative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you'll fit right in.
**The Purpose:** Slickdeals is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to help shape how we grow by partnering with Product, Design, Engineering, Finance, and Marketing to deepen our quantitative understanding of what drives user growth. In this role, you'll combine data science, statistics, and causal inference to develop the frameworks and insights that inform product decisions and shape our growth strategy. As a trusted cross functional partner, you'll turn complex business questions into actionable insights that help us build products our users love.

**What We're Looking For:**
* Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Sciences, or another quantitative field. * 8+ years of experience with Masters or 5+ years of experience with PhD * Strong track record designing, executing, and interpreting A/B tests using causal inference methodologies. * Proficiency in SQL and Python or R, with experience working with large scale datasets and data visualization tools. * Proven experience translating data into actionable recommendations for executives and cross functional teams. * Strong analytical mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and uncover meaningful insights from complex business problems. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in fast paced, cross functional environments.

**About The Company** VoltForce is working with an early-stage materials-inspection company on the search for a Metrology Data Scientist. Our client helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro- and nano-scale materials, the building blocks of critical sectors like energy storage, semiconductors, aerospace, and power systems. As demand surges and production grows more complex and faster, small undetected variations during manufacturing lead to waste, lower performance, higher cost, and safety risk, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind.
The company's platform changes that. It scans materials without damaging them, pairing a novel sensing approach with physics-informed machine learning to capture real-time signals that conventional methods cannot access. Those signals give manufacturers rare visibility into how materials behave as they are made.
The company turns that hidden data into actionable intelligence, helping manufacturers reduce variability and increase yield and performance. The platform can run as a standalone tool or integrate directly into production lines, and it is already in early deployment with leading global manufacturers.
**About The Role** We are seeking a Metrology Data Scientist to join the Applications Engineering team. In this role, you will build and deploy machine learning models that turn complex, high-dimensional sensor signals into actionable predictions about material properties, bridging the gap between raw instrument data and the intelligence manufacturers act on.
This is a forward-deployed, customer-adjacent role. You will work directly with customer samples and datasets to execute proof-of-concept studies, validate model performance on novel materials, and translate results into product improvements. You will collaborate closely with software and hardware engineering teams to move models from research into production.
**What You'll Do** **Model Development & Calibration**
* Build, calibrate, and validate predictive models that map sensor signal features to material properties * Design and evaluate new model architectures and featurization strategies suited to small-data, high-dimensional scientific datasets * Apply methods including regression, dimensionality reduction, probabilistic modeling, anomaly detection, and physics-informed ML
**Model Validation & Production Readiness**
* Develop testing and validation frameworks for model performance, including uncertainty quantification and out-of-distribution detection * Characterize model robustness across sample types, process conditions, and instrument configurations * Prepare models and documentation for handoff to the software engineering team for production deployment
**Customer-Facing Proof-of-Concept Work**
* Analyze datasets from customer proof of concepts * Compile technical reports and supporting materials to deliver to customers * Translate findings and stakeholder feedback into model improvement roadmaps
**Required** **What You Bring**
* B.S. in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field with 3 to 5 years of applied ML/data science experience; or M.S. with 1 to 3 years (Ph.D. a plus, not required). MINIMUM of 1 year post-graduation industry experience required * Hands-on experience building and validating predictive models (supervised and self-supervised) in Python * Ability to analyze multivariate, high-dimensional datasets and perform feature engineering and selection * Solid grasp of statistical modeling: uncertainty quantification, regularization, covariate analysis, and feature importance methods * Strong communicator, comfortable presenting technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
**Preferred**
* Experience working with time-series, spectroscopic, or other sensor-based signal data * Prior work in manufacturing, materials science, energy storage, semiconductors, or another physical science domain * Prior customer-facing or applications engineering experience in a technical product company * Experience deploying models in production software environments * Familiarity with data pipeline development (PostgreSQL or similar) * Fluency in Mandarin Chinese, Japanese, German, Korean, or another key stakeholder language
It's ok if you don't check all the boxes. We hire for the capacity and the drive to learn and grow. If there is something you haven't done, but you are capable, please apply!
VoltForce does not work on a Corp-to-Corp (C2C) basis.

item.title: Staff Applied Scientist - LinkedIn
item.description:
LinkedIn is the worlds largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. Were also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture thats built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun where everyone can succeed. Join us to transform the way the world works.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
LinkedIn’s Data Science and Applied Science teams use data, experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and AI to solve important product and business problems. With more than 1 billion members globally and products that span both consumer and enterprise use cases, LinkedIn offers scientists the opportunity to work on problems that directly shape member experience, customer value, growth, and monetization.
We are looking for a strong individual contributor who can bring rigorous science to practical problems. In this role, you will work across areas such as experimentation, causal inference, prediction, measurement, optimization, personalization, and large-scale machine learning. You will be expected to go deep technically, build methods and models that fit real product needs, and turn promising ideas into tools, platforms, and systems that can be used at scale.
The ideal candidate combines technical depth with strong product and business judgment. You should be comfortable developing methods from the ground up, adapting existing techniques to new problems, and working closely with cross-functional partners to make better decisions and deliver measurable impact. The work may span areas such as auctions, matching, market design, personalization, AI-powered product experiences, and other high-impact systems across LinkedIn.
Responsibilities
* Independently identify and frame complex, ambiguous data science problems, surfacing high-impact opportunities for product and solution improvement. * Lead advanced analyses, experimentation, machine learning, and causal inference efforts to inform product strategy and data-driven decisions. * Leverage AI tools in day-to-day workflows to increase productivity * Design and refine modeling approaches by evaluating technical tradeoffs and developing scalable, replicable solutions with measurable business and product impact. * Research and evaluate historical approaches, internal repositories, external literature, and novel methods to determine the best path forward when standard solutions are insufficient. * Establish or improve methodological frameworks, review peer work, and uphold high standards for scientific rigor, reproducibility, fairness, and analytical integrity. * Develop and implement advanced data science methodologies and ML models that are accurate, unbiased, robust, and aligned with scientific best practices. * Build and improve production-ready data science solutions while accounting for latency, cost, infrastructure, reliability, and maintainability constraints. * Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, AI, and leadership to translate strategic priorities into clear data science roadmaps and deliverables. * Influence stakeholders through clear insights, recommendations, and advocacy for AI/ML methodologies and data-driven innovation.

item.title: Data Scientist II - Crunchyroll
item.description:
**About Crunchyroll** Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
**About The Role** We are seeking an exceptional Data Scientist II to join our Machine Learning and Data Science team, with a focus on supporting and shaping content strategy through rigorous statistical analysis, traditional machine learning, and predictive modeling. This role will partner closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, content strategists, product leaders, and business stakeholders to develop models and insights that inform how we understand audiences, evaluate content performance, forecast outcomes, and optimize decision-making across the content lifecycle. We are considering applicants for the location of Los Angeles, CA or San Francisco, CA.
The ideal candidate will have experience in traditional machine learning methods, strong statistical foundations, and hands-on experience working with large-scale behavioral and content datasets. Key areas of focus will include user clustering and segmentation, behavioral modeling, content performance analysis, time series forecasting, audience engagement prediction, and KPI forecasting across acquisition, viewership, retention, monetization, and lifecycle outcomes.
This is a cross-functional role for someone who is both technically rigorous and commercially curious. Success in this position requires strong judgment in model selection, feature engineering, validation, experimentation, and interpretation, as well as the ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. The right candidate will bring a strong command of machine learning fundamentals and a passion for using data to better understand users, content, and the dynamics that drive long-term engagement.
**What You Will Do:**
* Develop and implement machine learning models that support content strategy, including user clustering, behavioral segmentation, engagement prediction, content affinity modeling, and audience lifecycle analysis. * Analyze large-scale user behavior, content consumption, and performance datasets to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that inform content investment, programming, personalization, and growth strategies. * Apply traditional machine learning techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, tree-based models, ensemble methods, survival analysis, uplift modeling, and time series forecasting to solve complex business problems. * Design feature engineering, model validation, backtesting, and evaluation frameworks to ensure models are accurate, interpretable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives. * Partner with content, finance, strategy, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous business questions into structured data science problems and actionable recommendations. * Collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Engineers to productionize models, improve data pipelines, and ensure reliable, repeatable workflows across data science initiatives. * Document methodologies, assumptions, experiments, model outputs, and business implications clearly to support transparency, collaboration, and stakeholder adoption. * Stay current with advances in statistical modeling, machine learning, forecasting, behavioral analytics, and content intelligence, and natural language processing while maintaining a strong grounding in proven, interpretable modeling techniques.
**About You** We get excited about candidates, like you, because:
* You have 2+ years of experience in data science roles, preferably in technology, media, entertainment, streaming, subscription, or consumer product environments. You have demonstrated success applying data science to user behavior modeling, audience segmentation, content performance analysis, forecasting, personalization, lifecycle analytics, or related applications. * You have a strong command of traditional machine learning methods and know when and how to apply them effectively. You are experienced with techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, dimensionality reduction, tree-based models, ensemble methods, survival analysis, uplift modeling, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting. * You are comfortable working with large-scale behavioral, engagement, and content consumption datasets. You can identify meaningful user segments, model content affinity and engagement patterns, evaluate title or catalog performance, and translate behavioral signals into actionable insights for content, product, growth, and strategy teams. * You are proficient in Python for data analysis and modeling, SQL for querying and transforming data, and visualization tools such as Tableau, matplotlib, or similar platforms. You have hands-on experience with machine learning libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, statsmodels, PyTorch, or similar tools. * You have experience building, validating, and communicating predictive models for business outcomes such as viewership, acquisition, retention, engagement, churn, monetization, or content ROI. You understand model evaluation, backtesting, feature engineering, interpretability, and the importance of aligning technical metrics with business goals. * You are adept at presenting complex analytical and machine learning findings in clear, actionable formats for both technical and non-technical audiences. You can explain methodology, assumptions, model outputs, tradeoffs, and business implications through concise narratives, dashboards, reports, and visualizations. * You hold a degree in data science, statistics, computer science, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative field. A master’s degree or advanced coursework in machine learning, statistics, econometrics, behavioral science, natural language processing, or related areas is preferred.
**About The Team** You will join an interdisciplinary team of Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and AI Engineers, united by a passion for leveraging data and ML/AI to create transformative solutions. Our team delivers both consumer-facing product features that enhance the streaming experience for millions of users and stakeholder-oriented solutions that empower internal teams with actionable insights. From building personalized recommendation systems to developing innovative tools like our stakeholder-facing chatbot, we combine cutting-edge machine learning, robust data pipelines, and advanced AI to drive impact across the organization. Collaboration, creativity, and a commitment to excellence define our team’s culture as we work together to push the boundaries of what’s possible in streaming and data-driven decision-making.
Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually. * Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self. * Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance * Health Saving Account HSA program * Health care and dependent care FSA * 401(k) plan, with employer match * Employer paid commuter benefit * Support program for new parents * Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!
